{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter for email channel only
email_only = df[df['channel'] == 'email']

# Filter for converted orders (converted = 1)
converted_email = email_only[email_only['converted'] == 1]

# Exclude QA orders (revenue_clean == 999999.99) and refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
excluded = (email_only['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99) | (email_only['status'] == 'refunded')

# Apply filters: only converted orders from email, not excluded
eligible_email = email_only[(email_only['converted'] == 1) & ~excluded]

# Calculate average revenue per converted order in the email channel
avg_revenue_email = eligible_email['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Output
print(f'Number of email orders: {len(email_only)}')
print(f'Number of converted email orders: {len(converted_email)}')
print(f'Number of QA orders in email: {len(email_only[email_only["revenue_clean"] == 999999.99])}')
print(f'Number of refunded orders in email: {len(email_only[email_only["status"] == "refunded"])}')
print(f'Number of excluded email orders (QA or refunded): {excluded.sum()}')
print(f'Number of eligible converted email orders: {len(eligible_email)}')
print(f'Average revenue per eligible converted email order: {avg_revenue_email:.2f}')"}
